title: Payment succeeded
description: A payment was paid through Stripe. For a wallet top-up the wallet was credited before this event; for a payment of an invoice (`invoiceId` is present) the wallet is credited and the invoice marked paid by the following `invoice.paid`. Sent only after Stripe's own webhook was verified; a browser redirect never causes it. This schema describes the `data` member of the delivered document; the envelope (id, type, tenantId, occurredAt, data) is described in README.md.

ledgerEntryId.description: The ledger entry of the credit. Absent for a payment of an invoice, which credits the wallet afterwards.

invoiceId.description: The invoice this payment was for. Absent for a wallet top-up.

money.description: An amount in minor units (cents, dong) of one ISO 4217 currency.
